title: Poker
description: Play five-card draw against the computer with the recovered text version.
versionOrder: Inferred presentation order: two closely related self-contained text saves, followed by graphical revisions. The text saves differ: tape12b save 6 reverses line 2190 and adds a debugging STOP. Later forms use LINE/GET/PUT extensions unavailable in the stock ROM. A separately corrected derivative of the selected text save is the playable default. Cross-tape chronology is not established.
